description: mix3 recipe (8-seed SiLU ensemble + ctx, mixed Gaussian/VP targets, 4372 configurations, z_s 0.2-12, train-only, validation checkpoint selection) on the training set regenerated with the halo-filament overlap correction: filament density x [1 - F(M_f, z)], F per cosmology from excursion-set walks, closed to the halo mass fraction (SGL_FILF=1).
supersedes: mix3-v1 (kept in model/checkpoints/analytic_mix3_v1, selectable by version)
limitations: Analytic default filament treatment kept (every filament core counted, no kappa threshold); the MC backend drops sub-threshold filaments, so the two backends respond differently to the fix.
z_s < 0.5 depends on the r200 halo-edge choice.
Lower-edge negativity of the Gaussian closure is larger than in mix3 (96 vs 6 configs below -1e-5 of the peak); handled by the assembler's edge cleaning.
Scored on validation; no test scoring.
